channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Tehran and U.S. Offer Conflicting Messages on State of Negotiations
item.description: President Trump said his administration had good talks with Tehran. An Iranian official confirmed review of a US plan to end the war. Israel struck targets near Beirut. President Trump said his administration had had “very good talks” with Tehran in the last 24 hours.

item.title: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes
item.description: Kyiv accused Russia of violating a ceasefire with fresh strikes. Ukraine war live: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes The Independent.

item.title: Iran reviewing US proposal to end war, though key demands remain unaddressed
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal to end the war. Key demands remain unaddressed. US President Donald Trump has issued an ultimatum for Iran to accept a deal to end the war or face intense renewed bombing.

item.title: Argentina investigates link to deadly hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship
item.description: Argentina is investigating a link to a deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship. Three deaths were reported. Three deaths reported from South America-related hantavirus as cruise ship remains off Cape Verde coast.

item.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship leaves Cape Verde after three evacuated
item.description: A hantavirus-hit cruise ship left Cape Verde after three people were evacuated to the Netherlands. A British man is among three evacuees sent to the Netherlands after displaying symptoms while aboard the MV Hondius.

item.title: In rare push, US lawmakers demand transparency on Israel nuclear capability
item.description: US lawmakers have demanded greater transparency on Israel's nuclear capabilities, citing heightened risks amid the US-Israel war on Iran. The push for clarity comes as tensions escalate in the region.

item.title: IDF attacks Beirut for first time since ceasefire agreed
item.description: Israel's military attacked Beirut for the first time since a ceasefire was agreed, escalating tensions in the region. The attack marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran.

item.title: Anthropic’s Mythos AI marks a cybersecurity moment Singapore cannot ignore
item.description: Singapore's cybersecurity landscape has been put on high alert by Anthropic's new AI model, Mythos. The model's potential to compromise national security has prompted warnings from top cybersecurity officials in the country.

item.title: Deepening Iran war and Hormuz crisis have left India sidelined
item.description: India's delicate balancing act in the Middle East has been disrupted by the deepening US-Israel war on Iran. The crisis has left New Delhi struggling to maintain its relationships with key regional players.

item.title: The heat is on Thailand to not just muddle through
item.description: Thailand's economy is facing mounting problems, including a slowdown in growth and rising debt. Decision-makers in the country are under pressure to address these issues and restore stability to the economy.

item.title: This Singapore designer turns food scraps, glass and textile waste into beautiful objects
item.description: Liu Tingzhi transforms food scraps and waste into objects through her studio Wastd. She saw the scale of textile waste while working in fashion. Liu Tingzhi first saw the scale of textile waste while working in fashion.

item.title: Oil prices tumble, stocks rally on Mideast peace hopes
item.description: US President Donald Trump said talks with Iran are progressing, leading to a drop in oil prices and a rise in global stocks.

item.title: Russia tells diplomats to leave Kyiv in case Moscow launches mass strikes
item.description: Russia told diplomats to leave Kyiv due to potential mass strikes. Moscow threatens retaliation if Ukraine attacks during Victory Day. Moscow threatens retaliatory strikes if Ukraine attacks Russia during Victory Day commemorations.

item.title: Iran considering US proposal to end war, official says
item.description: Iran is considering a US proposal to end the war. The White House believes a 14-point memorandum of understanding is possible. The White House reportedly believes it could be closing in on a 14-point memorandum of understanding with Iran.

item.title: SpaceX backs Anthropic with data centre deal amidst Musk’s OpenAI lawsuit
item.description: SpaceX signed a data centre deal with Anthropic, easing capacity constraints for the company. Deal gives IPO-bound SpaceX a marquee customer, while helping Anthropic ease capacity constraints. SpaceX backs Anthropic with data centre deal amidst Musk’s OpenAI lawsuit.

item.title: Trump says had ‘very good talks’ with Iran as Tehran reviews US proposal
item.description: Trump had talks with Iran about a potential deal. Tehran is reviewing a US proposal that could end the war. Momentum could be building for Washington and Tehran to strike a deal that could ultimately end the war.

item.title: Holders PSG beat Bayern Munich to reach Champions League final with Arsenal
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain beat Bayern Munich to reach the Champions League final. They drew the second leg 1-1 in Germany. Paris Saint-Germain draw the second leg of their semifinal with Bayern Munich 1-1 in Germany to take the tie 6-4.

item.title: What’s behind the secessionist movement in the Canadian province Alberta?
item.description: Alberta, Canada's oil-rich western province, may hold an independence referendum as early as October. The secessionist movement faces a complicated process ahead. Oil-rich western province could see independence referendum as soon as October, but complicated process remains ahead.

item.title: Israel bombs Beirut’s southern suburbs
item.description: Israel bombed Beirut's southern suburbs for the first time since a ceasefire took effect on April 17. The strike occurred in the area. Israel bombed Beirut’s southern suburbs for the first time since the ‘ceasefire’ took effect on April 17.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran with ‘higher level’ bombing if it doesn't reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump threatened Iran with increased bombing if the Strait of Hormuz is not reopened. The strait has ‌been virtually shut since the conflict began on February 28 with air attacks on Iran ‌by ⁠the U. S.
